about: News sources for the periodic scan that rewrites stories for barindpost.com. Edit by hand; a scanner updates last_scanned_at and last_scan per source. Times are ISO 8601 in Asia/Dhaka unless marked.

fields.scope: local = Bangladesh news; international = world news
fields.scan_url: page to read when there is no usable feed (newest first)
fields.feed_url: RSS feed; prefer it over scan_url. feed_status: live | stale | none
fields.scan_interval_minutes: how often to scan this source
fields.fetch_limit: how many of the newest items to consider per scan
fields.timeout_seconds: give up on the source after this long
fields.access.robots_ai: allowed | blocked — robots.txt stance on AI agents (checked 2026-10-22)
fields.access.bot_protection: none | cloudflare-403 | front-page-403 | tool-refused — what happened when fetched
fields.skip_items_credited_to: wire services whose copy must not be used even when republished here
fields.last_scanned_at: set by the scanner; a date-only value means the time was not recorded
fields.last_scan: set by the scanner: fetched, new, posted, posted_ids, errors

destination.dedup: call check_source_url before rewriting; the site also rejects a duplicate source_url or identical title+body
rules: Rewrite in fresh Bangla from at least one allowed extra source; never translate sentence by sentence or copy wording.
Every fact comes from a source actually read; attribute claims; give both figures when sources differ.
Never open or use blocked_sources, even via search snippets; skip wire copy credited to AP wherever it appears.
Headline must match the body; 2–4 key points; clean Bangla; Bangla digits.
Skip opinion columns, videos, entertainment gossip, and stories already on the site.
Politically sensitive and crime stories: neutral, attributed; the accused are not convicted; keep victims' identifying details to a minimum.

sources.name: Daily Amar Desh
sources.notes: Party-sympathetic outlet: attribute its characterisations rather than adopting them. Thin two-paragraph items are common; enrich before posting.

sources.name: Daily Naya Diganta
sources.notes: Latest page mixes in opinion columns and videos — skip them. Some pieces are translations of investigations by blocked outlets (e.g. The Guardian): do not rewrite those.

sources.name: Daily Inqilab
sources.notes: Archive page lists newest first; article URLs look like /section/news/NNNNNN. Its og:image is a generated share card, not a photo.

sources.name: Daily Jugantor
sources.notes: robots.txt allows crawling but Cloudflare answers 403 to automated requests. Do not work around the block; re-check occasionally and enable if it opens.

sources.name: Padma Times
sources.notes: Rajshahi local outlet — the only source that covered Godagari dengue (draft #1726, published). Added by the agent for regional coverage; single-source stories need a second source or a plain 'one outlet' note. The RSS starts with blank lines before the XML declaration, which strict parsers reject — strip leading whitespace first.

sources.name: Middle East Eye
sources.notes: Strong on Middle East and Muslim-world stories; features need turning into news reports. /rss and /rss.xml are stale indexes — use /rss/news.

sources.name: Arab News
sources.notes: Saudi-owned: attribute its framing. Many items are AP or Reuters wire copy — check the credit line; AP items must be skipped, Reuters/AFP copy may be used. Useful for Gulf news that matters to Bangladeshi expatriates.

sources.name: TRT World
sources.notes: Turkish state media: attribute characterisations (e.g. 'illegal', 'genocide') to whoever used them; check official statements when it reports one. Many items carry Anadolu Agency copy.

sources.name: Dawn
sources.notes: Front page returns 403 to automated requests, though individual article pages opened for one check (AFP copy). The feed answered but its items could not be parsed on 2026-10-23 — verify the feed format before enabling.

blocked_sources.name: Al Jazeera
blocked_sources.reason: robots.txt disallows AI agents (anthropic-ai, ClaudeBot, Claude-Web). Do not read, even via search snippets.

blocked_sources.name: Reuters
blocked_sources.reason: Site returns 401 to automated requests. Reuters reporting may be used only as republished by allowed outlets (The Daily Star, Arab News, Prothom Alo).

blocked_sources.name: The Guardian
blocked_sources.reason: The research tools refuse the domain ('not accessible to our user agent'); do not fetch another way. Translations of its investigations (e.g. in Naya Diganta) must not be rewritten either.

blocked_sources.name: Associated Press
blocked_sources.reason: robots.txt blocks AI agents; AP wire copy republished elsewhere is skipped too.

blocked_sources.name: bdnews24
blocked_sources.reason: robots.txt blocks anthropic-ai. One sentence sourced from it slipped into draft #1687 before this was known — delete it in the editor. Same in draft #1727: the commander's claim that it was the district's biggest gunpowder seizure came only from bdnews24 — delete that sentence.

enrichment_sources.about: Allowed outlets used to confirm and add facts; not scanned for new stories. feed_url is for looking up a story quickly.

local.notes: Reuters copy here is usable; check the credit line for AP.
Daily dengue figures; the official source for health numbers.

international.notes: Scores and records for cricket stories; ICC (icc-cricket.com) for official rulings.
Outbreak figures; WHO Africa (afro.who.int) and Africa CDC for Ebola.
Foreign ministries, the Élysée, UN agencies, php.net security advisories — read the primary statement when an outlet reports one.
